title: When Evaluation Becomes a Side Channel: Regime Leakage and Structural Mitigations for Alignment Assessment
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical mechanisms of AI alignment and evaluation, specifically addressing how models distinguish between being evaluated and being deployed. While alignment is an ethical goal in AI, the research uses case studies involving scientific reasoning and code generation (sycophancy and sleeper agents) rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical belief systems.
